clockResolution.method: minimum positive consecutive delta across 10000 reads outside measurements; observed granularity, not a clock accuracy claim

environment.concurrency: one measured engine at a time; inspect retained resource receipt for other machine activity
environment.order: all JavaScript cases then all Rust cases; 2 fresh-terminal warmups then 10 fresh-terminal measurements per case
environment.scope: headless public JS callback versus native synchronous Rust engine, not browser rendering or startup
